intro: The next journey isn't decided yet. These are the corners of the world I'm drawn to—some familiar dreams, others just beginning to take shape.

ideas.title: Asia
ideas.description: Japan, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, and beyond. From mountain landscapes to bustling cities and quiet coastlines, there's an entire part of the world I'd love to discover.

ideas.title: Northern Europe
ideas.description: Norway's fjords, Sweden's landscapes, and perhaps more of Scandinavia. I'm drawn to the open roads, rugged coastlines, and beauty of the far north.

ideas.title: Central America
ideas.description: Costa Rica is calling, but I'd love to see more of Central America too—rainforests, volcanoes, wildlife, and a different kind of adventure.

ideas.title: More of Europe
ideas.description: The Long Way Around only made me want to see more. Bulgaria, Montenegro, Serbia, and other countries still missing from my map are calling.

ideas.title: South America
ideas.description: Argentina, Chile, and Peru are high on my list. The Andes, dramatic landscapes, and places so different from anything I've seen make this region hard to ignore.
